purpose: Teach: 桂/柏/藍/圭/乃/嘉/肇/ヨウ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「桂剥きが出来る様になれ」って料理を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to teach you how to do katsura-peeling — it's a proper cooking skill.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Speaking as if sharing something genuinely worth being proud of. Slight lift at the end—inviting him to feel what she feels about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと柏餅を食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, I ate kashi-mochi with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright, direct. The simple clarity of a six-year-old reporting something that felt important. Small upswing at the end—wanting to be heard.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが私に藍染めのストールを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave me this indigo scarf.
lines.style: Soft, almost surprised by the kindness. Touching the moment gently—not making a show of it, but letting him see that it mattered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「圭くん家にもよろしくね」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me to say hello to Kei's house when I see them — to be nice to them.
lines.style: Earnest and careful, like he's remembering instructions that felt important. Slight pause before delivering the second part—making sure he's getting it right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「美乃ちゃんとも仲良くね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying you should be kind to Mino too.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Almost thinking aloud while she speaks. A small pause midway—as if she's considering how to pass this along in just the right way.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと嘉節、つまり良い節句を祝ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I celebrated a good festival day with Dad — a kajo — marking the season and everything.
lines.style: Quiet pride in getting the word right. Slow, deliberate pacing—he's worked to understand and remember this. Slight breathiness on 'kajo,' like he's proud of knowing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「肇くんは命名の頃から元気だね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Hajime has been energetic ever since he was first named — right from the start.
lines.style: Reflective, almost gentle musing. A long, easy pace. The tone of someone noticing something kind that was said, and passing it on without embellishment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「ヨウ素入りうがい薬」を勧めて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad recommended iodine gargling solution to me — said it's good for staying healthy.
lines.style: Earnest and clear, finishing with quiet satisfaction. The tone of a child reporting practical advice he understands matters. Slight settling at the end—the natural close of sharing something complete.
